controls.requirement: Keep three hydrogel baselines and common transmission normalization.
Keep heating/cooling direction and pre-buckling missingness.
Observe out-of-plane motion rather than flattening it into desired in-plane metrics.
Include incompatible-spacing control and defects; morphology does not prove programmed dose.
Record every cycle and failed attempt, plus first/last checkpoints.
Check adjacent connectivity and distinguish printed crosses from enclosed analysis regions.
Use matched exposure, illumination, polarizer alignment and registration before assigning intensity changes to buckling.
Require distinct ordinary/polarized observations and approved combined map.
Own-specimen baseline and current calibration precede each measured comparison.
